scenes.text: Ek packet instant noodles khate hi body mein kya hota hai?
Sabse pehle, mouth mein chewing ke saath saliva starch ko break karna shuru karta hai.
Phir food stomach mein jaata hai, jahaan muscles aur digestive juices ise mix karte hain.
Small intestine mein enzymes carbohydrates ko aur chhote sugars mein todte hain.
Ye nutrients absorb hokar bloodstream tak pahunchte hain. Glucose body energy ke liye use ya store kar sakti hai.
Lekin ek aur cheez important hai — sodium! Instant noodles mein sodium ka amount brand aur flavour ke hisaab se badalta hai.
Isliye packet ka nutrition label check karo, aur vegetables aur protein add karke meal ko more balanced banao.
Food ko fear se nahi, science se samjho. Ye hai Food Code!
